description: What changed on Japanese prefectural election schedule pages since a date? From this service's own daily reads: elections added, modified (with before/after dates and the changed fields), removed from the page, and pages that disappeared, became unreadable or came back. History starts at tracking_since. Free window: last 30 days (an earlier since is clamped; see history_window). Election-level facts only. Check the official page before relying on a date.

change_type.description: Optional filter: added, modified, removed_from_page, page_gone, page_restored or page_unreadable

prefecture.description: Optional filter: prefecture name, JIS code (13) or local government code (130001)

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

name: election_changes

changes.description: Changes observed by this service on the schedule pages, oldest first.

date_changes.description: For modified: each date that moved on the page, with the previous and new date. The reason is not inferred.

history_window.description: Free history window applied to this answer.

clamped.description: true when requested_since was earlier than the free window and the answer covers only the window.

free_days.description: Days of recorded history served free of charge.

older_history.description: Status of recorded history older than the free window.

requested_since.description: The since you asked for (normalized to ISO 8601).

served_since.description: The since actually applied: requested_since, or the start of the free window if requested_since was earlier.

official_check.description: Read first: check the official election commission page(s) listed here before relying on any date.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

tracking_since.description: When this service first read a schedule page. Nothing before it was observed.

title: Election schedule changes since a date
